meta.revisionPolicy: Revised continuously; finalised over ~3 years. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: All-India, annual GVA by the 18 sub-industries MoSPI publishes (inside agriculture, manufacturing, trade and hotels, and transport), levels, real growth and share of nominal GVA
meta.note: Sub-industries are published with the revised estimates only, so they end at the last year standing at a revised estimate. Each sub-industry's group names its parent industry.
